name: nook
description: Native browser primitives for popovers, tooltips, and selects.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nook/core build && pnpm --filter @nook/react build && pnpm --filter @nook/website build
scripts.check: prettier --check . && pnpm lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm --filter @nook/react check:compiler
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @nook/react test && pnpm --filter @nook/website test
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/test-results packages/*/node_modules/.cache website/test-results website/.vitepress/cache website/.vitepress/dist
